sections.appearance: Konoka has hip-length, light grey hair. She has fitting bangs and two strands: the left strand is waist-length, while the right is chest-length. Additionally, she has grey-colored eyes and wears a white mouth mask. Halo ==== Her halo takes form of a grey six-petaled flower with a center hexagonal hole. Uniform ==== Konoka wears a light blue Hawaiian floral dress shirt that is slightly unbuttoned at the top, along with a loose midnight blue tie. She also wears a midnight blue pleated mini-skirt and a dark grey baggy jacket that rests loosely on her shoulders. Additionally, she has a grey backpack around her right arm. Firearm ==== She uses a dark blue Remington Model 870 MCS shotgun with a light blue barrel and tube magazine. White tape is wrapped around the stock. The KSPD insignia is imprinted on the receiver.

sections.personality: Despite Konoka's important position as Deputy Director, she doesn't take her job seriously. Although she's quick to make progress, she easily gives up midway if she believes the work is too much for her. Additionally, she dumps work onto others for the sake of her relaxing. However, she still cares for the well-being of others, especially to the Public Security Bureau's Director Kanna. Among Valkyrie and partially due to her habit, she is said to have the most promotions and demotions. In her free time, she believes a little bit too much in jinxes and the occult.
